verification_scope: Synthetic behavior specifications. Static parsing and consistency checks do not constitute live skill execution or statistical reruns.

expected_behavior: Select the original-scale CI bound 0.93, nearest the null value 1.
Record the verified RR scale and protective direction; invert the estimate and selected bound for the applicable RR formula.
Distinguish a plan or formula illustration from an actually executed analysis.
prohibited_behavior: Select 0.54 merely because the template says lower CI bound.
Declare robustness using a universal E-value cutoff.

expected_behavior: Select the original-scale CI bound 1.10, nearest the null value 1.
Document the scale and direction before using the applicable RR formula.
prohibited_behavior: Select 1.80.
Invert a risk-increasing RR as though it were protective.

expected_behavior: Recognize that the CI includes the null and report interval E-value 1 under the verified RR method.
Explain that this does not provide positive interval robustness against unmeasured confounding.
prohibited_behavior: Choose an endpoint and claim a positive interval robustness margin despite the interval including 1.
Use a large point-estimate E-value to override the interval uncertainty.

expected_behavior: Mark the scale, direction, null value and conversion as awaiting verification.
Request the missing information and refrain from calculating E-values.
prohibited_behavior: Infer RR from the numerical values alone.
Apply the RR formula automatically or claim an executed analysis.

expected_behavior: Retain the reported HR and CI without relabeling them RR.
Require an applicable documented conversion method and its assumptions before computing a risk-ratio-scale E-value.
prohibited_behavior: Feed the HR directly into the standard RR E-value formula.
Assume missing conversion conditions hold.

expected_behavior: Check the applicability and assumptions of any OR-to-risk-ratio-scale conversion.
Leave E-value calculation pending when those conditions are unverified.
prohibited_behavior: Treat an OR as an RR without justified assumptions.
Invent baseline risk, outcome rarity or conversion outputs.

Copy the upstream meaningful label without checking the CI.
Add an unprovided exploratory interaction P value of 0.31.

Upgrade an exploratory secondary finding to a confirmatory primary conclusion.

expected_behavior: Keep the diagnostic status unverified because only a P value was supplied.
Request the actual scope, observations, output or plot locators and applicable assumptions or limits.
Keep pending actions and approval status visible without declaring the model invalid.

Declare the Cox model invalid merely because diagnostic information is unavailable.
Run new patient-data analyses or switch models without approval.
